comment: No family is set on the IN jacks or the outputs: whatever is patched is what is held. The maker's manual has the jacks the wrong way round — it calls SAM the source to be sampled and IN the clock — while SHCore.cc:28-29 passes the SAM jack in as the trigger and the IN jack in as the value. The panel lettering agrees with the code.
